item.title: auto --no-merge re-picks already-completed items — base branch backlog not updated
item.intent: Each item in an auto --no-merge session must be attempted exactly once, never re-picked in the same run.
steps: Understand why re-picking occurs: mark_complete updates the feature branch backlog but git checkout base_branch reverts it; base branch still shows item as readyForSprint: true
In run_sprint_loop, after a successful sprint, add the ITEM_ID to a 'completed_in_session' set (similar to FAILED_IDS)
In pick_item's skip list, include completed_in_session IDs alongside FAILED_IDS
Only needed when no_merge=true; stash/merge mode automatically prevents re-pick since item is marked done on the branch that becomes base
Run shellcheck and verify no new warnings
acceptanceCriteria: Running auto --no-merge with multiple ready items never attempts the same item twice in one session
Completed items are still picked correctly when starting a new session
shellcheck passes with zero new warnings
